mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) FROM sys_user u

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.nickname, u.phone, u.email, u.avatar_url AS avatarUrl, u.org_id AS orgId, o.org_name AS orgName, u.status, u.last_login_at AS lastLoginAt, u.created_at AS createdAt, u.created_at AS createTime, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT r.id ORDER BY r.id) AS roleIds, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT r.role_name ORDER BY r.sort_order SEPARATOR ',') AS roleName FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_org o ON o.id = u.org_id AND o.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted = 0
GROUP BY u.id ORDER BY u.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user (org_id, username, password_hash, nickname, phone, email, status, password_updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{orgId}, #{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{nickname}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{status}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
